decision_reason: The six normalized TatMapper episodes provide useful second-repo evidence diversity, but they are all review_required, below the 10-episode minimum used for the alpha limited pilot, and lack full CI logs or fresh local Flutter/Android reruns. They are not yet sufficient for even a limited v1.7-beta second-repo scoring run.
